examples.label: Check if anonymous login is enabled

notes:
Config: /etc/vsftpd.conf (settings), /etc/ftpusers (denied users)
Dangerous: anonymous_enable=YES, anon_upload_enable=YES, anon_mkdir_write_enable=YES, no_anon_password=YES, write_enable=YES, anon_root=..., hide_ids=YES, ls_recurse_enable=YES
NSE: ftp-anon, ftp-syst, ftp-brute, ftp-bounce, ftp-vsftpd-backdoor, ftp-proftpd-backdoor, ftp-vuln-cve2010-4221, ftp-libopie
Port: 21/tcp
